name: CaseMarginTopInFlow
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "margin-top-in-flow" (box). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: margin-top: 12px on the SECOND child of a flex column whose parent declares no gap
